messages:
emma-cs: Heads-up — AcmeRetail just escalated. Their QA assistant used to list order line items; after last night's canary->stable swap it returns an empty 'items' section for many orders. Customer shows only a tiny template tweak (wrapped placeholder) was changed before rollout.

jon-eng: Can you paste the exact request payload + request_id? Also which model variant + route?

emma-cs: Request id: req_2026_11_03_07. Attached minimal repro payload below (redacted customer ids). They're calling /v1/generate on redwood-2-13b with our hosted route `orders-summarize`.
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-2-13b",
  "route": "orders-summarize",
  "input": {
    "system": "You are a compact order summarizer.",
    "template": "Order summary:\n- header: {{header}}\n- items:\n{{items}}\n- footer: {{footer}}",
    "data": {"header":"Order #1234","items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2}],"footer":"Thanks"}
  }
}
```

sophia-ml: Quick thought — we shipped a minor templating library bump in the canary that changes how placeholders with non-alphanumeric wrappers are parsed. Any chance their tweak used extra punctuation?

emma-cs: They said they changed the placeholder to use angle brackets earlier in the week: `<'items'>` -> `{{<items>}}` (customer-side change), but it only started failing after our rollout.

alex-sre: When did the canary->stable promote run? Any deploy metadata?

deploy-bot: deploy-notice: route=orders-summarize, canary->stable promote, user=deploy_pipeline, ts=1995548000, commit=9f3c2a7, changelog="templating: bump mustache-lite 1.2.0 -> 1.2.1"

jon-eng: I can repro locally. If the placeholder is wrapped by angle brackets our mustache-lite fork treats `<` as delimiter start and strips the token, resulting in empty insertion. Old version treated `<` as literal. That explains why customer change only surfaced after our bump.

jon-eng: Quick mitigation: rolling back the templating bump on the route should restore behavior. Longer-term we should patch parser to accept angled placeholders or document allowed placeholder formats.

alex-sre: Rolling back canary->stable for orders-summarize now. rollback job started (job id rb_1995550001). Will follow up with completion.

deploy-bot: rollback-complete: job=rb_1995550001, status=success, ts=1995550018, commit=9f3c2a7->8d2b1c4

emma-cs: Told AcmeRetail we rolled back and asked if they can re-run. They confirmed their bot output restored for a few sample orders. Customer happy for now but asked for a permanent fix.

sophia-ml: Filing a patch ticket to update templating parsing behavior + add unit tests for edge wrappers. I'll link PR when ready.

jon-eng: PR idea: normalize placeholder scanning to treat anything inside `{{...}}` as literal content until `}}` — avoid interpreting `<` or other punctuation as delimiter. I'll spike and post results.

emma-cs: Thanks team :raised_hands: — I'll follow up with the customer and keep them in the loop.

alex-sre: Adding incident label and root-cause notes to the deploy audit. :white_check_mark:
